trainer/30856.htm.text: Magister Winonin: Desmond frightens me, and I'm not afraid to admit it. He becomes stranger with each passing day. Why are Human Wizards like Drikiyan and Desmond so bizarre? Woe is me, to be caught in the uneasy truce between Human and Elf! I must be the most unfortunate Elf Wizard in the world...

Some evil souls will simply not be absorbed, and, if you happen to collect the wrong soul, the crystal will shatter... Q00350_EnhanceYourWeapon/30856-08.htm.text: Magister Winonin: Please choose one of the following three types of crystals: Each crystal bestows a different power upon the weapon it enhances, and the powers may vary from weapon to weapon.

Q00350_EnhanceYourWeapon/30856-09.htm.text: Magister Winonin: Here is a red soul crystal. Collect souls into it and take it to a blacksmith along with the weapon you wish to enhance. The stronger the weapon, the more souls needed to enhance it. Next time we meet I hope you have gained more strength.

Q00350_EnhanceYourWeapon/30856-10.htm.text: Magister Winonin: Here is a green soul crystal. Collect souls into it and take it to a blacksmith along with the weapon you wish to enhance. The stronger the weapon, the more souls needed to enhance it. Next time we meet I hope you have gained more strength.

Q00350_EnhanceYourWeapon/30856-11.htm.text: Magister Winonin: Here is a blue soul crystal. Collect souls into it and take it to a blacksmith along with the weapon you wish to enhance. The stronger the weapon, the more souls needed to enhance it. Next time we meet I hope you have gained more strength.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
